units: <cite ref="Sukkah 48b:5">Succ. 48ᵇ</cite> <he>יומא חד שבקוך ושויוך פ׳</he> (Ms. M. <he>שבקתך</he>, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note) one day they will send thee off (from heaven) and make thee a runner (to show the way).
<cite ref="Sanhedrin 38b:20">Snh. 38ᵇ</cite> <he>אפי׳ בפ׳ נמי לא קבילניה</he> even as a guide we refused to accept him.

<cite ref="Sanhedrin 82a:13">Snh. 82ᵃ</cite>, a. fr. (a proverbial expression) <he>קריינא דאגרתא איהו ליהוי פ׳</he> let him who dictates the letter be the carrier, i.e. let him who gives the advice be its executor.
